tools.notes: Runs one exact repository command once, with literal cwd/argv and no inferred test counts or proof credit. Workers select only frozen assigned entrypoint/selection IDs and timeout; orchestrators/reviewers retain harness execution. All executable retries re-enter current schema, session binding and listed-definition checks before source/runtime work. Responses remain at most 1,024 UTF-8 bytes; retained reads execute nothing. Public file/runner/selector execution is removed; native internal proof/regression consumers retain their own contract.
use_when: A worker runs one assigned entrypoint/selection, exactly as its frozen assignment lists it.
An orchestrator/reviewer runs an actual repository harness command; orchestrators name source, reviewers use their bound source.
An earlier answer supplies a retained read or explicit corrected retry; copy the exact returned call.
do_not_use_when: The question is whether saved proofs hold; use verify_proof.
A worker needs an unassigned focus or changed listed definition; request_assignment_change is the supported route.
The request names public file, runner, selector, environment variables, another root or forged role; those controls are not worker inputs.
authoritative_for: Native command outcome, at most one authorized parent comparison, and retained current native results; no proof credit.

recommended_first_call.operation: run the assigned selection or role-authorized repository harness

tools.notes: Read compact canonical context, then one semantic selection from its returned reference. A WK subject's context facts carry the advisory terminal_review_designation; a findings unit's context facts and each inventory:"slices" member carry its effective review_purpose when one exists. Both are read-only observations of the saved record that grant or withhold no dispatch, admission, integration or handoff decision.
use_when: Read compact canonical context, then one semantic selection from its returned reference.
do_not_use_when: The request needs an ungranted role, caller-selected repository or another task.
authoritative_for: Read compact canonical context, then one semantic selection from its returned reference.

recommended_first_call.operation: Read compact canonical context, then one semantic selection from its returned reference.
